task.title: P6-037: Finish the vacuous-test guards in e2e-suite and fix the standing instance
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-037. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Finish the vacuous-test guards in the `e2e-suite` skill and fix the instance still standing** (verified PARTLY 2026-07-30 — the fixture-distinguishability guard already landed at `e2e-suite:138-142`; the **positive-control** and **shared-provenance** guards did not). The pattern, filed once rather than per instance: *a test cannot distinguish behaviors its fixture does not distinguish.* The two guards still to write down: **a negative assertion needs a positive control proving the subject was rendered at all**, and **an assertion sharing provenance with the code under test has no independent authority**. The live instance: `catalog.spec.ts:601`'s owned-badge negative assertion still has no positive control, so it passes whether the tile is present-without-a-badge or absent entirely.
